// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/kit-report: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const KIT_ENTRY_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_KINDS: readonly ["skill", "prompt", "role", "tool", "mcp"];

export declare const KIT_LIMITS: {
    readonly nameChars: 200;
    readonly descriptionChars: 2000;
    readonly where: 20;
    readonly whereChars: 200;
    readonly declared: 64;
    readonly entriesPerReporter: 2000;
    readonly rolesPerPack: 64;
};

export declare const KIT_MANAGE_LINK_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_PACK_ID_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_PLUGIN_SOURCE_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_REPORTED_ENTRY_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_REPORT_INPUT_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_REPORT_INPUT_TYPE = "molis.kit-report.input.v1";

export declare const KIT_REPORT_OUTPUT_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_REPORT_OUTPUT_TYPE = "molis.kit-report.output.v1";

export declare const KIT_SOURCE_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_TOOL_ORIGINS: readonly ["runtime", "gateway", "business", "subagent", "plan-step", "builder"];

export declare const KIT_UPGRADED_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export declare const KIT_VERSION_SCHEMA: ActionSchema;

export type KitAvailability = {
    available: true;
} | {
    available: false;
    reason: string;
    detail?: string;
};

export interface KitDeclared {
    tools: string[];
    permissions: string[];
    connector_categories: string[];
}

export type KitEntry = KitReportedEntry & {
    key: KitEntryKey;
    source: KitSource;
    reporter: {
        provider_id: string;
        title: string;
    };
    pack: KitPackId;
    in_packs?: KitPackId[];
};

export type KitEntryKey = string;

export type KitKind = (typeof KIT_KINDS)[number];

export interface KitManageLink {
    href: string;
    label: string;
}

export type KitMcpRef = {
    part: "server";
    owner: "project" | "connection";
    server_id: string;
    configuration_version: number;
} | {
    part: "action_tool";
    action: ActionReference;
} | {
    part: "tool" | "prompt" | "resource";
    server_id: string;
    name: string;
} | {
    part: "outbound";
    client_id: string;
};

export interface KitMcpState {
    server_enabled?: boolean;
    health?: "connected" | "disconnected" | "unavailable" | "not-reattached";
    action_available?: boolean;
    granted_to?: Array<{
        client_id: string;
        title: string;
        external_tool?: ExternalToolId;
    }>;
}

export type KitPackId = string;

export interface KitReport {
    entries: KitReportedEntry[];
    packs?: KitReportedPack[];
}

export type KitReportInput = Record<string, never>;

export interface KitReportedCommon {
    entry_id: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    version: KitVersion;
    declares: KitDeclared;
    scope: "project" | "home";
    where: string[];
    availability: KitAvailability;
    usage: KitUsage;
    manage?: KitManageLink;
    export: "package" | "user_data" | "reference" | "none";
    source?: KitSource;
    pack?: KitPackId;
}

export type KitReportedEntry = (KitReportedCommon & {
    kind: "skill";
    skill: SkillCatalogEntry;
}) | (KitReportedCommon & {
    kind: "prompt";
    ref: {
        owner_id: string;
        prompt_id: string;
    };
    prompt: {
        use: "agent" | "instruction";
        edited: boolean;
        roles: KitRoleRef[];
    };
}) | (KitReportedCommon & {
    kind: "role";
    ref: KitRoleRef;
    role: {
        subagent: boolean;
        execution?: AgentRoleExecution;
        host_tools: string[];
    };
}) | (KitReportedCommon & {
    kind: "tool";
    ref: {
        tool: string;
    };
    tool: {
        origin: KitToolOrigin;
        writes: boolean;
    };
}) | (KitReportedCommon & {
    kind: "mcp";
    ref: KitMcpRef;
    mcp: KitMcpState;
});

export interface KitReportedPack {
    install_id: string;
    status: "enabled" | "disabled" | "uninstalled";
    upgraded?: {
        from: string;
        to: string;
        at: string;
    };
}

export type KitRoleRef = {
    kind: "plugin";
    owner_id: string;
    role_id: string;
} | PersonalCharacterRef | ProjectCharacterMemberRef | {
    kind: "assistant";
};

export type KitSource = {
    kind: "plugin";
    plugin_id: string;
    title: string;
    version: string;
    install_id: string;
    publisher_label: string;
    trust: SkillPackTrust;
} | {
    kind: "system";
    module: string;
    title: string;
} | {
    kind: "runtime";
    package: string;
    version: string;
} | {
    kind: "character";
    role: PersonalCharacterRef | ProjectCharacterMemberRef;
    title: string;
    revision: number;
} | {
    kind: "mcp_server";
    owner: "project" | "connection";
    server_id: string;
    label: string;
} | {
    kind: "outbound";
    title: string;
};

export type KitToolOrigin = (typeof KIT_TOOL_ORIGINS)[number];

export type KitUsage = {
    kind: "recent";
    count: number;
    last_at: string | null;
    kept: {
        rows_per_key: number;
    } | {
        days: number;
    };
} | {
    kind: "last_only";
    last_at: string;
} | {
    kind: "none";
} | {
    kind: "not_counted";
};

export interface KitVersion {
    label: string;
    change?: {
        kind: "default_updated";
        base_version: number;
        default_version: number;
    } | {
        kind: "discovered";
        added: number;
        removed: number;
        changed: number;
    };
}

export declare function defineKitReportAction(capabilityId: string, version: number, title: string, permissions: string[], options?: {
    scope?: "project" | "home";
    audiences?: ActionAudience[];
}): ActionDefinition<KitReportInput, KitReport>;
